purpose: Maps the current implementation to the approved target architecture, and states the Creative relationship for each. Nothing is moved by this audit; every 'migration_required' entry is a proposal requiring architect approval.
rules_applied: ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md Rule 5 — external contracts are frozen
ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md Rule 6 — repository abstraction only where justified
ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md Rule 7 — strangler: wrap and delegate, never duplicate
ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md Rule 11 — strict layer dependency direction

layers.target_responsibility: Pure business rules, value objects, domain contracts, domain states, domain services. No HTTP, no Eloquent, no SDKs, no transaction orchestration.
current_to_target_gaps: 6 Domain files import App\Models (9 edges) — unenforced debt
7 imports in CampaignPricingEngine point Domain -> Services — pinned debt
No aggregates, no repository implementations, no domain events other than AssetCreated (dead)
layers.creative_relationship: NEW. app/Domain/Creative/** does not exist and must be created with zero App\Models and zero App\Services imports.

layers.target_responsibility: Application / use-case orchestration. Coordinate domain operations, repositories, transactions, external contracts, workflows.
current_to_target_gaps: 28 classes still flat at the root (recorded Phase 0.20 debt)
~30 of 48 do direct Eloquent instead of going through repositories
10 open DB::transaction; the class is both application layer and data layer
layers.creative_relationship: EXTEND with a new app/Services/Creative subdirectory. Creative application services only; no legacy service may be called from Creative domain code.

layers.target_responsibility: Layer being retired. Reporting (17) and payment/financial use cases (15) are the deliberate survivors.
current_to_target_gaps: Being retired; no new class may be added
layers.creative_relationship: DO NOT USE. Creative has no place in app/Application.

layers.target_responsibility: Repository contracts + persistence-facing abstractions where isolation/complex query/testability is justified (Rule 6).
current_to_target_gaps: Only Asset and Booking have repositories; 4 capabilities have none (recorded P2 debt)
layers.creative_relationship: NEW app/Repositories/Creative with contracts + implementations, matching the Asset/Booking precedent.

layers.target_responsibility: Adapters, vendor drivers, persistence implementations. May depend on Laravel and vendor SDKs. SDK types must not leak inward (Rule 3).
current_to_target_gaps: No app/Infrastructure/Persistence directory — Eloquent repositories live under Payments/ and Financial/Persistence/ instead
layers.creative_relationship: REUSE all 6 existing contracts as-is. A private-disk contract is NEW WORK (see storage artifact).

layers.target_responsibility: Controllers, Requests, Resources, Middleware. Thin: validate/authorize -> invoke use case -> respond.
current_to_target_gaps: 68 controllers, of which ScreenController and DashBoardController are fat (Rule 1 violations)
Only 5 Form Requests for 385 routes; most validation is inline
layers.creative_relationship: NEW app/Http/Controllers/Creative, app/Http/Requests/Creative, app/Http/Resources/Creative, built to the thin pattern with a policy layer.

layers.target_responsibility: Genuinely cross-cutting: Events, Jobs, Exceptions, Authorization, Configs.
current_to_target_gaps: Support -> Services imports (7) are recorded debt
layers.creative_relationship: EXTEND Events (new notification events) and Configs (new creative_* groups). Authorization gains policies, not a new algorithm.

layers.target_responsibility: Active Record persistence. Retained and justified per Phase 0.20. Must not reference the HTTP layer (Rule 11).
current_to_target_gaps: A Model -> Http inversion was found and fixed in Phase 0.14 (User::hasPermission resolving PermissionMiddleware)
layers.creative_relationship: NEW Creative models. The Creative domain must NOT reference them; only Creative repositories may.

class_level_mapping.current_responsibility: Razorpay order creation, signature verification, payment confirmation + referral attribution + booking status transition, fetch, refund
class_level_mapping.creative_relationship: NEEDS_ARCHITECTURAL_DECISION — the gateway contract is reusable, the booking-coupled confirmation flow is not

class_level_mapping.current_responsibility: Paise/rupee conversion and normalisation; int paise for the gateway, float rupees rounded to 2dp for persistence
class_level_mapping.creative_relationship: REUSE for gateway amount conversion only. Creative must define its own money value object for domain arithmetic, because the existing Money class has no add/subtract/allocate operations.

class_level_mapping.current_responsibility: Screen-provider settlement period lifecycle: generate, approve, markAsPaid, cancel
class_level_mapping.creative_relationship: PATTERN ONLY. The eligibility predicate is hard-wired to screen_providers and booking_screens.settlement_status.

class_level_mapping.current_responsibility: Affiliate partner commission lifecycle; its pessimistic lock was extracted to EloquentPartnerCommissionRepository::findOrFailForUpdate in Phase 0.10
target_location: App\Services\Financial or a new Commission capability
class_level_mapping.creative_relationship: NEEDS_ARCHITECTURAL_DECISION — the only complete approve->paid->cancel machine in the repo, but bound to partner_commissions semantics

class_level_mapping.current_responsibility: File upload/delete via StorageContractInterface plus booking-media validation-rule builders
class_level_mapping.creative_relationship: WRAP/ADAPT — the only zero-Eloquent file primitive in the repository

class_level_mapping.current_responsibility: Single notification dispatch point: config gate -> recipient resolution -> MailContractInterface -> notification_logs
class_level_mapping.creative_relationship: EXTEND — add a creator recipient role and creative_* config keys

class_level_mapping.current_responsibility: 33 synchronous event handlers mapping events to mailables and recipients
SINGLE owner of the permission algorithm (Rule 12). Role-slug -> role_permissions lookup, 3600s cache. No super-admin bypass.
class_level_mapping.creative_relationship: REUSE AS-IS. Creative permissions are granted through the same matrix. Creative must NOT implement a second permission algorithm.

class_level_mapping.current_responsibility: Route-boundary authorization; contains the super-admin bypass
class_level_mapping.creative_relationship: REUSE AS-IS for all Creative routes

class_level_mapping.current_responsibility: Provider onboarding: enquiry->approve, portal invitation, reject, create, update, revenue-split update, activity log, notes, timeline
target_location: Would become Provider capability; currently un-migrated
class_level_mapping.creative_relationship: STRUCTURAL TEMPLATE for creator onboarding/profile, but its 5 inline transactions and 6 models must be extracted, not called
PATTERN ONLY for the Creative Project state machine. Booking status vocabulary is wrong.

class_level_mapping.current_responsibility: DB-cached key/value settings with 11 typed accessors
class_level_mapping.creative_relationship: EXTEND with creative_* groups — lowest-risk reuse in the repository
DO NOT USE. It is a creator profile that shares a name with an advertiser profile — a trap. Only uploadAvatar():209 is generic.
DO NOT USE the service. 'Asset' means media inventory, not creative work files. The repository pattern is a good template but the subject is wrong.

class_level_mapping.current_responsibility: @deprecated facade delegating 10 report getters to ReportQueryRegistry
class_level_mapping.creative_relationship: DO NOT USE. Creative reporting must add ReportQuery implementations to the registry, or a new Creative query namespace, not extend this facade.
PATTERN ONLY — the only ledger-with-balance implementation in the repo, but it is non-cash points tied to bookings.

class_level_mapping.current_responsibility: WebP compression ladder (70KB target, q80->q20 step 10), raw file_put_contents, no DB writes
class_level_mapping.creative_relationship: DO NOT CALL from Creative. It bypasses the storage contract, uses an unsanitised path, has no size/mime policy, and only ever used by FileController (which is itself unsafe).

policies.current_state: ABSENT — would be the FIRST policy layer in the repository

new_adapters_required: A private-disk storage adapter (signed URL access) — NEW WORK, no precedent exists
